articles.title: Newscast - MPs Vote Against Assisted Dying Bill - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: MPs vote against the assisted dying bill with 286 votes against and 270 in favour.
articles.body: Today, MPs have voted against a fresh move to legalise assisted dying in England and Wales. The bill would have allowed adults with fewer than six months to live to apply to be given help to end their life. It followed hours of debate and the result was close with 286 against and 270 in favour. Adam is joined by Ailbhe Rea, Political Editor of the New Statesman and Lara Spirit, Deputy Political editor of the Sunday Times to unpack the politics of the result and to reflect on the other big events in Westminster this week. Including the moment the new Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced a fundamental shift on the government’s approach to Israel. Also, they discuss the news that Zack Polanski has been confirmed as the Green Party candidate for the Holborn and St Pancras by-election taking place next month, and whether the greens think they can win. articles.summary: Yemen's Houthis have seized territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait - a key trade gateway for oil and global shipping.
articles.body:
Fighters from the Iran-backed Houthi group have seized territory close to the Bab al-Mandab Strait in the Red Sea - a key trade gateway that links Asia and Europe.

Houthis have said they pose no threat to international shipping but have reiterated their intention to target vessels from Saudi Arabia.

Saudi Arabia has increasingly relied on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: How does assisted dying work in other countries?
articles.summary: About 400 million people have access to some form of assisted dying - what are the policies of other countries?
articles.body:
Around 400 million people now live in countries which have legalised assisted dying.

Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Spain and Austria have all introduced assisted dying laws since 2015 – when UK MPs last voted on the issue – some allowing assisted death for those who are not terminally ill.

Just last month, France adopted an 'aid in dying' law for adults with incurable conditions causing them unbearable pain.

While most jurisdictions forbid medical help to die, assisted dying laws around the world vary.

Across the US, assisted dying - which some critics prefer to call assisted suicide - is legal in 30 out of 50 states, as well as in Washington DC.

Oregon was one of the first places in the world to offer help to die for some patients, in 1997, and so has nearly 30 years' experience. It has become the model on which other US assisted dying laws have been framed.

In Oregon, assisted dying is open to terminally ill , mentally competent adults expected to die within six months - and must be signed off by two doctors. Since 1997 , 5,520 people have received a prescription for a lethal dose of medication - with 3,691 deaths.

In a 2025 report , 61% of patients who ask for help to die had cancer, 14% had a neurological condition like motor neurone disease and 11% had heart disease. Of the 400 patients who took a lethal dose of medication last year, the vast majority (89%) said loss of autonomy was a key concern, while others cited:

Losing control of bodily functions (47%)

Concern about being a burden on family and friends (43%)

Financial implications of treatment (4%)

In Oregon, as in other US states that permit assisted dying, the lethal medication must be self-administered - the same is proposed in England and Wales. Around one in three of those prescribed a lethal dose don’t go ahead with it.

Oregon is important for supporters of assisted dying in England and Wales as they point out it has remained restricted to terminally ill adults since its introduction. However, opponents say some of the rules have been relaxed. A residency requirement has been lifted, which means it is open to people from outside the state. The number of assisted deaths has also risen substantially over the years.

Canada is the country often cited by opponents of assisted dying as an example of the so-called "slippery slope" - a place where assisted dying has been extended and made available to more people since it was first brought in. Medical assistance in dying (Maid) was introduced in 2016, initially just for the terminally ill.

This was amended in 2021 and extended to those experiencing "unbearable suffering" from an irreversible illness or disability.

It had been due to be extended to people with a mental illness but that is now on hold.

Critics say the more the law is widened, the more disabled and vulnerable people will be put at risk. There has also been a dramatic growth in the number of people using Maid.

Roughly one in every 20 deaths in Canada are now medically assisted , compared to about one in 100 in Oregon.

Across Europe, six countries have some form of legalised assisted dying: Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Spain, Austria and - most recently - France. In all of them - unlike the proposals in England and Wales - help to die is not restricted to the terminally ill.

Switzerland was the first country in the world to create a “right to die” when it made assisted suicide legal in 1942. It is one of the few countries which allows foreigners access to help to die via organisations like Dignitas, in Zurich. More than 600 Britons have died at Dignitas in the past two decades, including 43 last year. The lethal medication must be self-administered.

The Netherlands and Belgium both legalised assisted dying more than 20 years ago for patients experiencing unbearable suffering from an incurable illness, including mental health issues. It has since been extended to children - the only European countries to allow this. Both allow euthanasia - or physician-assisted dying.

Most recently, Spain and Austria have legalised assisted dying for both terminal illness and intolerable suffering. In Austria, the drugs must be self-administered, whereas in Spain a medical professional can administer them.

In England, Wales and Scotland, parliament has so far rejected assisted dying proposals.

But assisted dying has already been legalised in one part of the British Isles.

In July, Royal Assent was given to a bill in Jersey. Unlike at Westminster and Holyrood, the legislation was introduced by the Jersey government, which says it will take about 18 months to set up the service. The first assisted death could happen late next year. There will be a residency requirement of one year, in a bid to prevent so-called 'death tourism'.

The measure, which most sets apart the Jersey legislation from the rest of the British Isles, concerns the manner in which those eligible for an assisted death can end their lives.

Individuals will be able to choose to have a doctor administer a lethal dose intravenously, as happens in Spain, Canada, New Zealand and most of Australia.

This is, in effect, voluntary euthanasia. It has become the preferred method of assisted dying in jurisdictions which allow this choice.

The laws proposed at Westminster, Holyrood and Tynwald - Isle of Man - all state that death must be by self-administration, which usually means the individual swallowing a lethal dose.

The Isle of Man assisted dying bill was passed by Tynwald (the Manx parliament) in March last year. As a UK Crown Dependency - like Jersey - it could not become law until granted Royal Assent.

This was declined earlier this year by the UK Ministry of Justice, but Tynwald has since passed an updated bill which has been sent back to the UK government for a second time.

If Royal Assent is granted, the Isle of Man expects the service to be operational next year. There is a residency requirement of five years.

In the past few years voluntary assisted dying has become legal across most of Australia. Last month, the Northern Territory parliament became the last part of Australia to pass Voluntary Assisted Dying legislation.

In New Zealand, patients must be terminally ill and expected to die within six months. That is extended to 12 months for those with a neurodegenerative condition in much of Australia.

In both countries, patients can self-administer the lethal medication. But it can also be administered by a doctor or nurse, usually via an intravenous injection.

Additional reporting by Anthony Reuben and Gerry Georgieva

articles.title: Barra Mansa segue em estágio de atenção após chuva e 9 ocorrências | G1
articles.standfirst: Município acumulou quase 62 mm de chuva em 24h; previsão indica instabilidade até domingo (13).
articles.summary: Município acumulou quase 62 mm de chuva em 24h; previsão indica instabilidade até domingo (13).
articles.body:
Chuva de 61,8 mm mantém Barra Mansa em estágio de atenção. — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

Barra Mansa (RJ) permanece em estágio de atenção por conta das chuvas contínuas que atingem a cidade desde a noite de quinta-feira (10). De acordo com a Defesa Civil, o acumulado pluviométrico atingiu 61,8 milímetros nas últimas 24 horas.

Até o momento, o órgão contabilizou nove atendimentos relacionados ao temporal , sendo seis ocorrências durante a madrugada e outras três ao longo da manhã desta sexta-feira (11).

Previsões do Centro de Previsão de Tempo e Estudos Climáticos (CPTEC/Inpe) e do Centro Nacional de Monitoramento e Alertas de Desastres Naturais (Cemaden) indicam que a instabilidade deve persistir, com pancadas de chuva moderada no município até domingo (13).

Por conta do cenário de solo encharcado, a Defesa Civil emitiu dois comunicados de alerta operacional para risco elevado de deslizamentos de encostas e alagamentos pontuais.

As equipes também acompanham as réguas dos principais cursos d’água do município, que seguem dentro dos limites de segurança: o Rio Barra Mansa marcou 1,04 metro (cota de transbordo em 2,10 metros); o Rio Bananal registrou 1,90 metro (cota em 5,30 metros); e o Rio Paraíba do Sul apresentou nível de 2,05 metros (cota em 4,50 metros).

A recomendação aos moradores de áreas de encosta ou sujeitas a inundações é atenção redobrada a sinais de trincas em paredes e movimentação de terra, evitando transitar em pontos alagados.

Em caso de emergência, a Defesa Civil atende pelos telefones 199 e (24) 98121-3427 (WhatsApp). O acionamento do Corpo de Bombeiros pode ser feito pelo 193.

articles.title: Detento foge de presídio em Mossoró durante trabalho na unidade | G1
articles.standfirst: Fugitivo foi identificado como Bartogaleno Alves Saldanha. Essa é a terceira fuga registrada no sistema penitenciário estadual apenas no mês de setembro.
articles.summary: Fugitivo foi identificado como Bartogaleno Alves Saldanha. Essa é a terceira fuga registrada no sistema penitenciário estadual apenas no mês de setembro.
articles.body:
Bartogaleno Saldanha fugiu da penitenciária Mário Negócio, em Mossoró — Foto: Divulgação/Seap

Um preso que fazia atividade laboral na Penitenciária Mário Negócio, em Mossoró , fugiu logo após pedir para ir ao banheiro na unidade durante um serviço que executava. De acordo com a Secretaria de Estado da Administração Penitenciária (Seap), ele estava sendo escoltado quando fugiu.

O fugitivo foi identificado como Bartogaleno Alves Saldanha , que, em 2025, também ficou foragido ao romper a tornozeleira eletrônica um dia após ser condenado a 18 anos de prisão por um assassinato em Campo Grande.

A fuga aconteceu na manhã desta sexta-feira (11) e foi a terceira registrada no sistema prisional do Rio Grande do Norte apenas no mês de setembro. Os titulares da Seap também deixaram a pasta nesta semana (detalhes mais abaixo) .

As circunstâncias da fuga não foram informadas. Em nota, a Seap informou que o preso fugiu enquanto realizava atividade laboral na penitenciária e que as forças de segurança e equipes da Seap estão mobilizadas quanto à recaptura do interno.

Até a atualização mais recente desta reportagem, o preso não havia sido recapturado.

Essa é a terceira fuga registrada no mês de setembro no sistema prisional do estado.

🗓️ No dia 3, Matheus Phelipe Constantino da Silva, de 27 anos , da Penitenciária Rogério Coutinho Madruga, em Nísia Floresta, fugiu da UPA de São José de Mipibu, onde estava estava internado desde o dia 29 de agosto após um surto psicótico. Ele foi recapturado às margens da BR-101 dias depois.

🗓️ No dia 8 de setembro, o interno Anderson Stallone Flores dos Santos, de 38 anos , fugiu da Penitenciária de Alcaçuz, em Nísia Floresta, por uma obra de ampliação do módulo de saúde. Ele teria passado por duas linhas de concertina instaladas sobre a muralha da penitenciária. O detento não foi recapturado.

Na última quarta-feira (9), o secretário Helton Edi Xavier e a adjunta Arméli Marques foram exonerados da Secretaria de Administração Penitenciária.

O governo não informou o motivo da mudança e também não estabeleceu relação entre a troca na gestão da Seap com os episódios recentes registrados no sistema penitenciário.

O coronel Francisco Canindé de Araújo, secretário de Segurança Pública, assumiu interinamente a pasta.

O sistema penitenciário do Rio Grande do Norte registrou pelo menos duas fugas em massa neste ano.

Fuga em julho no Rogério Madruga Coutinho

Em julho, onze presos conseguiram escapar da Penitenciária Rogério Madruga Coutinho , em Nísia Floresta, após retirarem o vaso sanitário e cavarem um buraco para escapar da cela.

Pelo menos cinco presos acabaram recapturados , enquanto outros cinco permaneciam foragidos até esta sexta (11).

Fuga em maio na Penitenciária de Alcaçuz

Em maio, cinco presos fugiram da Penitenciária de Alcaçuz , que fica vizinha à Rogério Madruga Coutinho. Os detentos danificaram a cela e utilizaram uma corda improvisada, conhecida como "teresa", para pular o muro.

Segundo a Seap, eles escaparam durante intensas chuvas registradas na região. Até aquele momento, segundo a secretaria, a última fuga na unidade havia sido registrada em 2021.

Quatro dos cinco fugitivos foram recapturados . Até esta sexta-feira (11), o único foragido era Maycon Dias de Mora.

articles.title: Vaca morre após ser atropelada por carro em rodovia de MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Motorista do veículo ficou ferido e foi socorrido pelo Corpo de Bombeiros.
articles.summary: Motorista do veículo ficou ferido e foi socorrido pelo Corpo de Bombeiros.
articles.body:
Uma vaca morreu após ser atropelada por um carro nesta quarta-feira (9), em Poconé , a 105 km de Cuiabá. O motorista do veículo ficou ferido e foi socorrido pelo Corpo de Bombeiros. Em um vídeo registrado no local, é possível ver que a parte da frente do carro ficou amassada, enquanto o animal ficou na parte traseira do veículo (vídeo acima).

Segundo os militares, os bombeiros atenderam ao acidente entre o carro e o animal na Rodovia Adauto Leite, próximo ao distrito do Chumbo.

O condutor do veículo, de 48 anos, foi encontrado fora do carro, lúcido e comunicativo. Ele apresentava ferimentos no rosto, mas sem sangramento.

Após receber atendimento pré-hospitalar, o homem foi encaminhado para uma unidade de saúde para avaliação médica.

A dinâmica do acidente ainda é investigada.

articles.title: Após passagem de tornados e cheias de rios, cidades do Paraná suspendem aulas preventivamente | G1
articles.standfirst: Tornado em Espigão Alto do Iguaçu danificou escola. Ao menos 20 municípios e instituições de ensino adotaram medidas preventivas.
articles.summary: Tornado em Espigão Alto do Iguaçu danificou escola. Ao menos 20 municípios e instituições de ensino adotaram medidas preventivas.
articles.body:
As chuvas e tempestades que atingem o Paraná deixaram 5.482 pessoas afetadas em 34 municípios, segundo relatório da Defesa Civil Estadual divulgado às 11h30 desta sexta-feira (11). O balanço aponta ainda 26 pessoas desalojadas, uma desabrigada, três mortes e 1.130 casas danificadas.

Diante da previsão de novas chuvas e dos riscos provocados pelos temporais e pela elevação dos rios, municípios e instituições de ensino suspenderam aulas preventivamente nesta sexta-feira.

Moradores de áreas de risco que precisarem retirar preventivamente seus pertences por causa da possibilidade de enchente devem acionar a Defesa Civil.

Entre as cidades que adotaram a medida estão Castro, Rio Bonito do Iguaçu, Guaraniaçu, Guarapuava, Santa Maria do Oeste, Marquinho, Virmond, Agudos do Sul, União da Vitória, Espigão Alto do Iguaçu, Coronel Domingos Soares, Clevelândia, Fazenda Rio Grande, Mandirituba, Prudentópolis, Lapa e Matelândia.

Paraná registrou alagamentos — Foto: Reprodução/RPC

Também houve suspensão de atividades em instituições como a Universidade Estadual do Centro-Oeste (Unicentro), em Irati, a Universidade Estadual do Paraná (Unespar), nos campi de Paranavaí e Loanda, e o Instituto Federal do Paraná (IFPR), em Palmas.

Em União da Vitória, a suspensão atinge três escolas e duas creches.

Em Guarapuava, a Secretaria Municipal de Educação suspendeu as aulas da rede municipal no período da tarde desta sexta-feira.

O número de cidades e instituições com aulas suspensas ainda está sendo atualizado. A lista pode aumentar ao longo do dia, conforme prefeituras, secretarias de Educação e instituições de ensino divulgam novos comunicados sobre a suspensão das atividades.

Apaixonada por viagens, mãe amorosa: Quem era a médica encontrada morta em apartamento

Tornado danifica escola e deixa alunos sem aula

Dois tornados foram confirmados no Paraná, segundo Simepar — Foto: Defesa Civil

Em Espigão Alto do Iguaçu, no Sudoeste do Paraná, um tornado atingiu a área rural durante a madrugada de quinta-feira (10), segundo o Sistema de Tecnologia e Monitoramento Ambiental do Paraná (Simepar).

A passagem do fenômeno destruiu uma plantação de eucaliptos e causou danos em duas escolas. Mais de 100 alunos ficaram sem aula.

A cidade está entre os municípios que suspenderam as atividades escolares preventivamente nesta sexta-feira.

Em União da Vitória, a Prefeitura e a Defesa Civil monitoram o nível do Rio Iguaçu e a previsão de chuva.

A medição feita às 9h desta sexta-feira apontou o rio em 5,56 metros. A previsão para as próximas 24 horas é de que o nível chegue a 5,82 metros.

O município entrou na margem de emergência. Segundo a Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA), o Rio Iguaçu pode provocar enchentes quando chega a 6,5 metros. Em grandes enchentes anteriores, o nível passou de 8 metros.

Até as 22h de quinta-feira (10), dez famílias haviam sido retiradas de áreas de risco com apoio da Defesa Civil. Uma família estava em abrigo público.

Em Jataizinho, no Norte do Paraná, o Rio Tibagi está entre 1,5 e 2 metros acima do nível considerado normal.

Em Porto Amazonas, nos Campos Gerais, o nível do rio subiu pouco em relação à medição anterior, mas permanece em situação de alerta.

articles.title: Pitbull escapa de carro após batida e ataca homem na Bahia | G1
articles.standfirst: Ataque aconteceu em Arraial d’Ajuda, distrito de Porto Seguro. Vítima teve ferimentos nas pernas e nos pés.
articles.summary: Ataque aconteceu em Arraial d’Ajuda, distrito de Porto Seguro. Vítima teve ferimentos nas pernas e nos pés.
articles.body:
Uma câmera de segurança registrou o momento em que um homem foi atacado por um cachorro da raça pitbull em Arraial d’Ajuda, distrito de Porto Seguro, no extremo sul da Bahia. O ataque aconteceu em 4 de setembro e o dono do cachorro fugiu do local.

O ataque ocorreu após uma batida entre dois carros. Depois da colisão, um dos motoristas desceu do veículo e deixou a porta aberta, por onde o cachorro saiu.

O animal atravessou a rua e avançou em um homem que estava no acostamento. A vítima, que não quis ser identificada, não tinha nenhuma relação com o acidente de trânsito.

Câmera de segurança filmou ataque de pitbull em Porto Seguro — Foto: Reprodução TV Santa Cruz

Ao perceber o ataque, o tutor do animal correu para desvencilhar o cachorro da vítima, que chegou a cair no chão. Quando conseguiu pegar o animal, ele partiu em direção ao carro enquanto a vítima tentava atingi-lo com um pedaço de madeira.

O homem entrou no veículo e fugiu do local sem prestar auxílio à vítima e sem conversar com a dona do carro atingido na batida.

A vítima sofreu ferimentos nos pés e nas pernas. Apesar disso, a família informou que o homem está bem e que decidiu não prestar queixa.

articles.title: Chuva chega a 53 mm e ventania derruba galhos de árvore em Resende | G1
articles.standfirst: Maior índice pluviométrico foi registrado em Visconde de Mauá; Defesa Civil usou motosserra para desobstruir via no Parque Ipiranga II.
articles.summary: Maior índice pluviométrico foi registrado em Visconde de Mauá; Defesa Civil usou motosserra para desobstruir via no Parque Ipiranga II.
articles.body:
Resende registra chuva de até 53 mm e rajada de vento de 78,4 km/h. — Foto: Divulgação/Defesa Civil

Resende (RJ) registrou acumulados de chuva de até 53 milímetros e rajadas de vento que atingiram 78,4 km/h nas últimas 24 horas. Segundo a Defesa Civil, o maior volume de precipitação no município ocorreu no distrito turístico de Visconde de Mauá.

Os medidores pluviométricos do órgão apontaram ainda 42,5 mm em Vargem Grande, 39,5 mm no Jardim Jalisco, 36,8 mm no Ipiranga e na Cidade Alegria, 36,2 mm em Engenheiro Passos, 30 mm na Fumaça, 28 mm na Torre do Surubi, 25,8 mm no Cabral, 24,6 mm em Bulhões e 23 mm no distrito de Bagagem.

Por volta das 18h de quinta-feira (10), equipes da Defesa Civil foram acionadas para atender a uma queda de galhos na Rua Cláudia Assunção, no bairro Parque Ipiranga II. A vegetação cedeu com a força da ventania e bloqueou parcialmente o tráfego de veículos.

Os agentes realizaram a poda e o corte dos galhos com o auxílio de uma motosserra, liberando a pista em seguida após vistoria que descartou riscos estruturais no entorno.

Ainda conforme o órgão, a ocorrência não causou danos a veículos ou imóveis, e ninguém ficou ferido.

articles.title: Acidentes seguidos deixam um ferido e causam lentidão na Via Dutra | G1
articles.standfirst: Batidas traseiras aconteceram nos kms 271 e 272; primeira colisão bloqueou faixa sentido SP e gerou 2 km de lentidão; Segunda colisão, no sentido Rio, envolveu dois automóveis e deixou uma pessoa com ferimentos leves.
articles.summary: Acidentes nos km 271 e 272 em Barra Mansa envolveram caminhão e carros, deixou uma pessoa ferida e causou 2 km de lentidão.
articles.body:
Dois acidentes registrados em um intervalo de pouco mais de uma hora deixaram uma pessoa ferida e provocaram lentidão na Via Dutra (BR-116), na manhã desta sexta-feira (11), em Barra Mansa (RJ). As duas colisões traseiras ocorreram em trechos próximos da rodovia.

Segundo a CCR RioSP, concessionária que administra a rodovia, a primeira ocorrência aconteceu por volta das 7h25, na altura do km 271, na pista sentido São Paulo. A colisão envolveu um caminhão e um carro de passeio. Ninguém se machucou nessa batida.

Por causa do acidente, a faixa esquerda ficou interditada por cerca de meia hora para o atendimento das equipes de socorro, provocando aproximadamente dois quilômetros de congestionamento. O tráfego foi totalmente normalizado por volta das 8h20.

Cerca de uma hora depois, por volta das 8h35, a segunda batida foi registrada no km 272, na pista sentido Rio de Janeiro. A colisão envolveu dois automóveis. Uma pessoa sofreu ferimentos leves e foi atendida, enquanto outras três saíram ilesas. Não foi necessária a interdição da faixa nesse trecho.

articles.title: Eduardo Paes propõe 30% de ensino em tempo integral na rede estadual | G1
articles.standfirst: O ex-prefeito participou nesta manhã de uma sabatina promovida pelos jornais O Globo, Extra e Valor Econômico e pela rádio CBN.
articles.summary: Em sabatina, Eduardo Paes propõe ensino em tempo integral para 30% da rede estadual e a implementação de ginásios tecnológicos para elevar o Ideb do Rio de Janeiro.
articles.body:
Eduardo Paes, candidato do PSD ao governo do RJ — Foto: Reprodução

Eduardo Paes , candidato do PSD ao governo do RJ, propôs nesta sexta-feira (11) aumentar o ensino em tempo integral na rede estadual. O ex-prefeito participou nesta manhã de uma sabatina promovida pelos jornais O Globo, Extra e Valor Econômico e pela rádio CBN. Ele também disse que pretende começar por São Gonçalo a retomada de territórios dominados pelo crime .

“Metas principais: aumentar a educação em tempo integral . Vamos passar para 30% (no estado). Na cidade do Rio, vamos terminar 2028 com 70% das crianças estudando em tempo integral . O Estado do Rio está muito atrás do resto do Brasil”, declarou. “O RJ é o pior Ideb do Brasil.”

“Vamos levar o conceito do Ginásio Educacional-Tecnológico, o GET, que fizemos aqui na cidade do Rio de Janeiro , trazendo mais ciência, tecnologia, matemática para dentro das salas de aula”, prosseguiu.

“Vamos fazer um trabalho com as prefeituras porque boa parte do ensino fundamental é de responsabilidade delas, copiando muito o modelo do Ceará, que é o modelo mais bem-sucedido do Brasil”, continuou.

“Vamos buscar levar já o ensino médio e o ensino profissionalizante ao tempo integral, para permitir que o jovem saia do ensino médio, já com alguma qualificação para o mercado de trabalho.”

As entrevistas, realizadas no estúdio da redação do jornal O Globo, são conduzidas pelos apresentadores da CBN Rio Bianca Santos e Leandro Resende, pelo editor de Política do Globo, Thiago Prado, pelo colunista Bernardo Mello Franco e por Francisco Góes, chefe da sucursal do Valor Econômico no Rio.

articles.title: Caminhão 'afunda' após pista ceder em Nova Friburgo; VÍDEO | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a Prefeitura, o acidente aconteceu nesta sexta-feira (11) causado por problema na rede de esgoto; a Rua Coronel Zamith foi interditada.
articles.summary: Segundo a Prefeitura, o acidente aconteceu nesta sexta-feira (11) causado por problema na rede de esgoto; a Rua Coronel Zamith foi interditada.
articles.body:
Um caminhão "afundou" depois que o chão cedeu na Rua Coronel Zamith, no bairro Ypu, em Nova Friburgo , na Região Serrana do RIo, na manhã desta sexta-feira (11). O veículo ficou inclinado e preso no trecho da pista que desmoronou, em frente à fábrica Ypu.

A via permanecerá interditada até a remoção do caminhão e a avaliação das condições de tráfego. Segundo a prefeitura, ninguém ficou ferido.

A Prefeitura de Nova Friburgo informou que o afundamento foi provocado por um problema na rede de esgoto.

A concessionária Águas de Nova Friburgo, responsável pelo serviço de esgotamento sanitário, informou que equipes est no local realizando os reparos necessários e fazendo a retirada do caminhão.

articles.title: Feira de Santana: 193 anos de histórias que talvez você não conheça | G1
articles.standfirst: Cidade já teve “praia” e é um dos principais entroncamentos rodoviários do país. Feira de Santana reúne histórias curiosas, personagens importantes e mais de 660 mil habitantes.
articles.summary: De cidade que já teve “praia” a um dos principais entroncamentos rodoviários do país, Feira reúne histórias curiosas, personagens importantes e mais de 660 mil habitantes.
articles.body:
Centro de Feira de Santana — Foto: Reprodução/TV Subaé

Mais de 660 mil habitantes, seis rodovias, uma história que inclui até uma “praia” longe do mar e bairros com ruas batizadas em homenagem a jogadores de futebol e novelas. Feira de Santana , a segunda maior cidade da Bahia, completa 193 anos no dia 18 de setembro e carrega uma mistura de números, personagens e histórias curiosas que ajudam a formar a identidade da "Princesa do Sertão".

Para marcar o aniversário, o g1 reuniu dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística ( IBGE ) e curiosidades sobre o município, desde o crescimento da população até memórias dos feirenses. Confira:

De 51 mil para mais de 660 mil habitantes

Elevada à condição de município em 1833, Feira de Santana já aparecia entre as maiores cidades da Bahia no primeiro Censo Demográfico do Brasil, realizado em 1872, ainda durante o Império.

Naquele ano, o município tinha 51.696 habitantes e era o quinto mais populoso do estado.

Quase um século depois, em 1970, a cidade chegou a 187.290 moradores e se consolidou como a segunda maior da Bahia, posição que mantém até hoje. Entre 2010 e 2022, a população aumentou 10,7%, e chegou a 616.272 moradores .

Feira de Santana ocupa a posição de segundo município mais populoso da Bahia, de décimo do Nordeste e 34º do Brasil.

Uma cidade que influencia dezenas de municípios

Centro comercial de Feira de Santana — Foto: Jorge Magalhães

A importância de Feira também aparece quando o mapa aumenta de escala. O município é o polo central de uma das dez regiões geográficas intermediárias da Bahia, formada por 83 cidades do Centro-Norte do estado.

Ela tem uma região metropolitana formada por 16 municípios, incluindo a própria cidade. Entre os maiores estão São Gonçalo dos Campos , Conceição do Jacuípe , Riachão do Jacuípe , Irará e Coração de Maria .

A influência também aparece no comércio. Moradores de pelo menos 80 municípios vizinhos procuram Feira para fazer compras e utilizar serviços.

Princesa do Sertão, mas com Mata Atlântica

O apelido “Princesa do Sertão” pode causar uma surpresa.

Apesar da fama, o bioma predominante em Feira de Santana é a Mata Atlântica, embora o município também tenha áreas de Caatinga.

A cidade é formada por 50 bairros. De acordo com os dados do Censo 2022, os cinco mais populosos são:

As mulheres são maioria entre os moradores e representam 53,4% da população, o equivalente a 329.253 habitantes.

O percentual torna Feira de Santana o terceiro município mais feminino da Bahia , atrás apenas de Salvador e Itabuna .

Assim como acontece na Bahia, a maior parte da população feirense é parda. São 330.541 pessoas autodeclaradas assim, o equivalente a 53,6% dos moradores. Na sequência aparecem pessoas pretas (29,2%), brancas (16,9%), indígenas (0,2%) e amarelas (0,1%).

A cidade tem uma população proporcionalmente mais jovem do que a média da Bahia.

Em 2022, tinha 79.288 pessoas com 60 anos ou mais, o equivalente a 12,9% da população. No estado, essa parcela era de 15,2%. Entre os 417 municípios baianos, Feira tinha a 40ª menor proporção de idosos.

Além de expressiva em relação à população, em 2023 o município teve o quarto maior Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) da Bahia, com R$ 21,846 bilhões. Ficou atrás da capital Salvador, e de Camaçari , onde funciona o Polo Petroquímico, e São Francisco do Conde , onde está instalada a Refinaria Mataripe, ambas na região metropolitana.

A cidade onde estrada vira caminho para o Brasil

Quem conhece Feira sabe que falar da cidade também é falar de estrada. O município é cortado por seis rodovias.

Pela cidade passam produtos que saem do oeste agrícola da Bahia, da fruticultura do norte e das indústrias do Sul e Sudeste.

A localização também ajuda a explicar a influência comercial do município sobre dezenas de cidades da região.

Imagens da Lagoa de São José das Itapororocas em 2024 — Foto: Google Earth

Sim, Feira de Santana já teve uma “praia”. Na década de 1960, a Lagoa de São José das Itapororocas , no distrito de Maria Quitéria, foi transformada em um espaço de lazer durante a gestão do prefeito Joselito Falcão de Amorim.

O local ganhou areia branca, coqueiros, quiosques e passou a receber banhistas nos fins de semana. A atração ficou conhecida como Praia de São José.

A experiência, no entanto, durou poucos anos. Acidentes, dificuldades de acesso, o desaparecimento da areia e o processo de secamento da lagoa contribuíram para o fim da praia artificial.

Antes da transformação, a lagoa tinha importância para a comunidade quilombola de Lagoa Grande, que utilizava as águas para pesca, banho, lavagem de roupas e criação de animais.

Mais de cinco décadas depois, a antiga praia sobrevive principalmente na memória de quem viveu aquele período.

Até os nomes das ruas ajudam a contar a história do município . Ao longo do crescimento urbano, principalmente entre as décadas de 1970 e 1990, bairros e conjuntos habitacionais receberam nomes inspirados em futebol, novelas, religião, estados brasileiros, cidades, planetas e até aeronaves.

Bairro Cidade Nova faz homenagem ao tricampeonato da Copa de 70 — Foto: Google Maps

No Cidade Nova, por exemplo, as ruas homenageiam jogadores da Seleção Brasileira tricampeã mundial em 1970, como Pelé , Rivelino e Jairzinho .

No Gabriela, a inspiração veio da televisão, com ruas que receberam nomes de novelas como “Rei do Gado” , “Laços de Família” e “Torre de Babel” .

Já no George Américo, as ruas receberam nomes relacionados a aeronaves e espaçonaves. Na Queimadinha, a inspiração veio dos estados brasileiros.

Há ainda bairros com ruas dedicadas a deuses gregos, planetas, santos, rios, países e cidades.

Maria Quitéria — Foto: DOMENICO FAILUTTI_ACERVO DO MUSEU PAULISTA DA USP/BBC

Uma das principais personagens da Independência do Brasil na Bahia, Maria Quitéria de Jesus Medeiros , nasceu na cidade, na antiga Fazenda Serra da Agulha , na região onde hoje está o distrito que leva seu nome, na zona rural do município.

A história da heroína está espalhada pela cidade. Maria Quitéria dá nome à escola, avenida e ao Paço Municipal.

A pia onde ela foi batizada também é preservada em uma igreja histórica. Um memorial ainda possui um espaço dedicado à trajetória da militar.

Micareta de Feira de Santana — Foto: Ketheleen Serra/g1

A festa mais tradicional de Feira tem uma história tão curiosa quanto a própria cidade.

Com mais de 80 anos de tradição, a Micareta de Feira de Santana ganhou força depois de um episódio ocorrido em 1937.

Naquele ano, uma forte chuva atingiu o município e impediu a realização do carnaval na data prevista. A festa precisou ser adiada para depois da Quaresma.

A mudança teria sido sugerida por Maneca Ferreira, responsável pela organização de carros alegóricos. A proposta recebeu apoio da população e dos organizadores.

Foi assim, segundo a versão histórica mais conhecida, que nasceu a micareta.

Outro símbolo da cidade é o Feiraguay. O centro de comércio popular, conhecido pela variedade de produtos e pela ligação histórica com o comércio de mercadorias vindas do Paraguai, se tornou parte da identidade da cidade.

A trajetória dos comerciantes que construíram suas vidas no local também virou documentário. A produção foi feita a partir de pesquisa de campo, entrevistas, imagens de arquivo e registros do cotidiano do comércio.

Lausanne Vicente, adotada por meio das 'cegonhas da noite', em frente à casa da família adotiva — Foto: Maylla Nunes/g1

Uma das histórias mais intrigantes relacionadas à cidade envolve um esquema clandestino de entrega de bebês para adoção que teria funcionado por quase 30 anos, entre as décadas de 1980 e 2000. Quatro mulheres ficaram conhecidas como “Cegonhas da Noite” por intermediar a entrega de recém-nascidos a famílias interessadas em adotá-los.

Os bebês eram deixados nas portas das casas escolhidas, algumas vezes dentro de caixas e acompanhados de cartas.

Relatos apontam que mais de 2 mil crianças podem ter passado pelo esquema, embora não existam números oficiais que comprovem essa estimativa. A prática chegou ao fim depois que um juiz ameaçou prender pessoas envolvidas nas entregas, que aconteciam sem a intermediação da Justiça.

Décadas depois, a história voltou a ser discutida por pessoas adotadas que tentam descobrir suas origens.

Lagoa Grande — Foto: Divulgação/Carlos Augusto

A Lagoa Grande também faz parte da história de Feira. Localizada às margens da Avenida Eduardo Fróes da Motta, o Anel de Contorno, a lagoa integra um complexo de esporte, lazer e convivência.

O espelho d’água tem cerca de dois quilômetros de margem. Ao redor, há uma pista de caminhada e ciclismo de 2,3 quilômetros, campo de futebol, quadras esportivas, quiosques e estacionamento.

Hoje, além de espaço de lazer, a Lagoa Grande carrega parte da memória de Feira e da relação histórica dos moradores com a água.

Dos caminhos de boi que ajudaram a formar o município aos milhares de veículos que cruzam suas rodovias diariamente, Feira de Santana cresceu mantendo uma característica que parece atravessar sua história: ser ponto de encontro.

De pessoas, mercadorias, culturas, histórias e caminhos. Aos 193 anos, a segunda maior cidade da Bahia continua crescendo e se transformando, mas preserva marcas de diferentes épocas, algumas registradas nos números do IBGE, outras nas ruas, nas festas, nas lagoas e, principalmente, na memória de quem vive na Princesa do Sertão.

articles.title: Mulher é suspeita de matar colega e fazer live após o crime | G1
articles.standfirst: Amanda Carla da Silva, de 22 anos, foi presa em flagrante e diz que agiu para se defender de ataque. Marcus Vinicius Gonçalves da Silva, de 32, foi esfaqueado na madrugada de segunda-feira (7).
articles.summary: Amanda Carla da Silva, de 22 anos, foi presa em flagrante e diz que agiu para se defender de ataque. Crime aconteceu na madrugada de segunda-feira (7).
articles.body:
Uma mulher de 22 anos foi presa por suspeita de matar a facada o colega que dividia o apartamento, de 32, em Ribeirão Preto (SP). O crime aconteceu na madrugada de segunda-feira (7) e a família da vítima afirma que, após a morte, Amanda Carla da Silva transmitiu uma live nas redes sociais mostrando o corpo de Marcus Vinicius Gonçalves da Silva.

Os dois moravam juntos há dois meses, em um imóvel na Rua Geraldo Rinhel Sobrinho, no bairro Reserva Macaúba, onde o caso aconteceu. Aos policiais, Amanda disse que reagiu porque foi atacada por Marcus. Ele foi esfaqueado na região do pescoço.

Segundo ela, eles não tinham um relacionamento amoroso, mas a família de Marcus Vinicius nega e afirma que Amanda chegou a ser apresentada como namorada há duas semanas.

A família de Marcus Vinicius prestou depoimento pela manhã. Irmã da vítima, Ketlin Beatriz Silva de Jesus disse que não acompanhou a transmissão, mas recebeu prints de uma pessoa.

"Ela fez [a live] através do perfil dela. A gente não teve acesso à live em si, a gente teve acesso a prints de tela onde a pessoa printou que ela estava fazendo a live do perfil dela. Ela abriu uma live e no chão está o corpo dele".

Marcus Vinicius Gonçalves da Silva foi morto a facadas por Amanda Carla da Silva, em Ribeirão Preto, SP — Foto: Redes sociais

Amanda foi presa em flagrante e deve passar por audiência de custódia nesta sexta-feira (11). A EPTV , afiliada da TV Globo, não conseguiu localizar a defesa dela.

O boletim de ocorrência foi registrado como homicídio .

Família de Marcus Vinicius diz que Amanda Carla da Silva fez transmissão ao vivo após matá-lo em Ribeirão Preto, SP — Foto: Redes sociais

articles.title: VÍDEO: veja o momento exato das explosões em restaurante de Belém | G1
articles.standfirst: Caso ocorreu na rua Diogo Móia, no bairro do Umarizal. Destroços foram arremessados para o outro lado da rua e atingiram carros e outros comércios.
articles.summary: Caso ocorreu na rua Diogo Moía, no bairro do Umarizal. Destroços foram arremessados para o outro lado da rua e atingiram carros e outros comércios.
articles.body:
Uma câmera de segurança registrou o momento exato em que explosões após vazamento de gás causaram incêndio em um restaurante no bairro do Umarizal, em Belém , na manhã desta sexta-feira (11) - assista acima .

As imagens mostram vários veículos passando pelo local na hora do acidente. Algumas pessoas, assustadas, também saem correndo do local. A fumaça tomou conta da rua e afetou a visibilidade. Ainda não há um número exato de feridos .

A causa e a dinâmica da ocorrência só serão confirmadas após a perícia técnica, que analisa o local, os equipamentos, as instalações e os vestígios remanescentes. O local foi isolado para os procedimentos necessários.

Os bombeiros continuavam na área para o trabalho de rescaldo no início da tarde. O prédio também abriga apartamentos residenciais, que estavam sem moradores. Um dos apartamentos precisou ser interditado para análise técnica , de acordo com o proprietário.

A força das explosões foi tão intensa que destruiu diversos eletrodomésticos do restaurante . Pedaços de objetos, estilhaços de vidro e destroços foram arremessados para o outro lado da rua.

O impacto acabou atingindo veículos que estavam estacionados próximos ao local e fachadas de outros estabelecimentos comerciais vizinhos.

O trânsito na área permaneceu liberado e foi organizado por agentes do próprio Corpo de Bombeiros.

Um homem relatou momentos de pânico ao presenciar uma série de explosões em um restaurante na rua Diogo Móia , bairro do Umarizal, em Belém, nesta sexta-feira (11).

A vítima, identificada como Fledson Ribeiro, foi atingido por um pedaço de um objeto enquanto passava pela rua. Ele ficou ferido na perna e precisou receber os primeiros socorros do Corpo de Bombeiros, que foi ao local para controlar a situação. Não havia pessoas dentro do prédio onde fica o restaurante no momento das explosões.

"Eu entrei em pânico, mas graças a Deus já está tudo resolvido", desabafou Fledson, que estava do outro lado da rua e, mesmo assim, foi atingido por um pedaço de metal. O objeto, de acordo com ele, seria parte de um dos botijões.

Fledson, que trabalha próximo ao restaurante, ainda relatou que outras pessoas ficaram feridas, mas o número exato de atingidos não foi informado pelas autoridades.

Segundo os agentes, "o incêndio teria começado após a explosão de um recipiente de gás de cozinha com capacidade para 45 litros". Após a primeira explosão, ao menos mais duas foram ouvidas por moradores.

Trabalhador ficou ferido na perna e precisou receber atendimento do Corpo de Bombeiros após explosões em restaurante em Belém. — Foto: Reprodução / Wilk Dias / TV Liberal

articles.title: NI education: Girls given right to wear trousers to school
articles.summary: Guidelines stipulate that school uniform policies for the 2027/28 school year onwards must include the option for girls to wear trousers.
articles.body:
Students and politicians have been welcoming a change in legislation that will mean girls in Northern Ireland are to be given the legal right to wear trousers in school.

Revising guidelines, Education Minister Paul Givan said that, from the start of the 2027/2028 academic year, schools will be banned from prohibiting girls wearing trousers.

Year 13 pupil Connie Rogers has welcomed the change saying "girls should be able to wear trousers" if they want to.

"They can be a lot warmer and more comfortable," the 16-year-old said.

Connie, who has been wearing trousers to school for a number of years now, is also the president of the Secondary Students' Union of Northern Ireland.

"I really enjoyed wearing them," she said, adding: "especially in the winter months".

"I'm so happy that there's now legislation that all girls will be able to."

There are already laws on school uniform in Northern Ireland, and Givan had previously said they give girls the legal authority to challenge their schools . Education committee members, however, had called on the minister to go further.

Some assembly members have now accused the minister of making a "U-turn", with "substantial sums of public money" spent on drafting legislation "to fix his error of judgement".

It comes after assembly members passed a new law last year, aimed at addressing the cost of school uniforms in Northern Ireland - with these updated guidelines on wearing trousers now legally binding under the School Uniforms Act.

Speaking on BBC Radio Ulster's The Nolan Show , Givan said the change would come into immediate effect ahead of the next academic year.

"I don't need to go through the assembly to give effect to this," he said.

"Today, I am taking that decision, that will be formally communicated, schools will be hearing from me, and as of the next academic year...schools will be required that this has to be available if it is requested upon."

The minister explained that this change will not apply during the 2026/27 academic year, in order to allow schools to change their uniform policies.

Givan added that the change will also apply to physical education.

In a statement, Sinn Féin MLA Cathy Mason described Givan's decision as a "welcome but embarrassing U-turn".

"This is an important win for girls and for all those who campaigned for this simple choice," she said.

"The minister had the opportunity to guarantee this right in his own school uniforms legislation but failed to do so. It should not have required further legislation from the Education Committee to force movement on something so basic."

Mason added that girls' right to wear trousers "should never have been controversial and it should not have taken this long".

"We welcome that the minister has finally acted and will be watching closely to ensure he follows through and that girls are not let down."

In a statement, Alliance's education spokesperson, and chair of the Education Committee, Nick Mathison also described the decision as a "U-turn".

"I want to thank all of the young campaigners who have been bravely raising their voices about this, and whose dedication will lead to seeing this wrong righted," he said.

"The committee will be doing their full due diligence to guarantee the wording used in this update will ensure all girls are granted the right to wear trousers as part of their school uniform."

Mathison added: "Minister Givan will have to explain why he took so long to move on this issue. Substantial sums of public money have been spent on drafting legislation to fix his error of judgement, and we have said all along that he could have avoided this with the stroke of a pen."

A statement published on the Department of Education website said: "The guidelines issued today stipulate that school uniform policies for the 2027/28 school year onwards must include the option for girls to wear trousers throughout the school year, including for PE and Games.

"The guidelines are legally binding under the School Uniforms Act which came into operation earlier this year."

It added: "The Act is designed to help reduce the cost of school uniforms and ensure that affordability, comfort, practicality and sustainability are at the centre of school uniform policies."

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
articles.summary: Mokha's capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling a key international shipping route.
articles.body:
Yemen's Houthis have seized the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed pro-government forces, military sources and witnesses say.

The Houthis said they posed no threat to international shipping but reiterated their threat to target vessels from Saudi Arabia, which has relied on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.

On Friday, Yemeni government forces withdrew from the island of Perim in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, according to officials, with witnesses reporting that Houthi forces moved onto the island.

The strait is the southern gateway to a key shipping route that links Asia and Europe via the Red Sea and Suez canal.

The escalation of the conflict between the Houthis, Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia has contributed to a surge in oil prices.

Hundreds of people have reportedly been killed and thousands displaced since the Houthis launched an offensive in the south-west a week ago.

A Saudi-led coalition has also carried out air strikes on Houthi-controlled areas in western Yemen in support of the pro-government forces, and the Houthis have launched missiles and drones at cities and oil facilities in southern Saudi Arabia.

Mokha residents said Houthi fighters moved into the city after fierce clashes with pro-government forces on Wednesday night, prompting many families to flee their homes.

"The takeover came without warning. Panic spread throughout the area, forcing people to flee amid distressing scenes of injured people lying in the streets with no-one there to help them," one man told BBC Arabic's Middle East Lifeline programme.

Another man said that Houthi fighters were patrolling the streets of Mokha on Thursday, while government offices and shops were closed.

"At the moment, we don't know what Ansar Allah will do," he added, using the group's formal name. "Everyone is afraid for their safety."

Many displaced families are heading east towards the city of Aden, where Yemen's internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council and government are based.

"We fled with our children and kept running. We have no bedding, no home, nothing with us. Everything was destroyed within an hour. They didn't even give us a chance or warn us beforehand," one woman told BBC Arabic.

"We are women with no means of defending ourselves, and we have innocent children with us."

There was no immediate confirmation of Mokha's capture from the Houthis.

But the group's Supreme Political Council said in a statement on Thursday that clashes had "ceased in the western coast districts after the expulsion of Saudi enemy mobilisations", according to Houthi-run Al Masirah TV.

Tarek Salah, leader of the pro-government National Resistance Forces, also said he had moved his command centre on the west coast to a "safe location".

He added that his forces had paid "a heavy price in recent days in the face of a Houthi offensive that was planned and supported by Iran".

A Yemeni military source told AFP news agency that Houthi fighters had also seized Zuqar Island in the Red Sea, about 80km north-west of Mokha, after launching a barrage of rockets and a ground assault using boats.

On Friday, boats carrying Houthi fighters reached the island Perim - also known as Mayyun - after government forces withdrew, a local government official told AFP.

They said: "The Houthis have completed their takeover of the Bab al-Mandab area and Mayyun Island, which is located in the middle of the strait."

Meanwhile, the head of the Presidential Leadership Council, Rashad al-Alimi, urged Arab states and other countries to help protect Yemen's coasts and restore state control.

The Houthis' Supreme Political Council asserted its "right to defend [Yemen's] sovereignty and territorial waters while simultaneously reassuring the international community that navigation in the Red Sea remains safe".

However, the Houthi-run humanitarian operations co-ordination centre also stressed that the embargo on Saudi ships remained in place.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Sarea said Saudi warplanes carried out 64 strikes across the western provinces of Taiz, Hudaydah, Marib and Jawf over the previous 24 hours.

There was no immediate comment from the Saudi military.

However, the spokesman of the Saudi-led coalition of Arab states fighting in Yemen said on Wednesday evening that it would respond to a series of Houthi missile and drone attacks on the south-western Saudi cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha and Jazan.

On Tuesday, the Houthis launched dozens of drones and missiles at southern Saudi Arabia, injuring 73 civilians and causing fires at several oil facilities that led to a temporary halt in operations, according to Saudi authorities.

The Houthis said they were retaliating for dozens of Saudi air strikes on territory they control in recent days, including one on a prison in the town of Hazm in Jawf province on Monday that they said killed at least 23 civilians.

The Saudi-led coalition has backed Yemen's government against the Houthis in the country's devastating civil war for more than a decade.

A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.

The Houthis said they were retaliating for a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom.

articles.title: Reform UK's Norfolk police boss criticised for 127-date theatre tour
articles.summary: Colin Sutton's office says it will take place in his own time and will not affect his work.
articles.body:
A newly elected £79,000-a-year police commissioner is facing criticism for announcing a 127-date national theatre tour.

Opposition parties have questioned how Reform UK's Colin Sutton will be able to focus on his job overseeing Norfolk Police, which he was elected to in July.

The former detective is due to present his true-crime show in theatres across the UK next year discussing police investigations, with tickets priced at around £40.

A spokeswoman for his office said the tour "would not impact upon his ability to discharge his duties", but Labour MP Ben Goldsborough warned "you can't police a county from the back of a tour bus".

Sutton became one of the UK's most high-profile detectives in the 2000s, leading the investigation to catch serial killer Levi Bellfield , who murdered Milly Dowler, Marsha McDonnell and Amelie Delagrange.

After retiring from the Metropolitan Police, Sutton wrote a book about the case, which was later turned into an ITV drama .

He has also become a regular commentator in the media and last year was named as Reform's national policing and crime advisor.

In July, after the former Norfolk Police and Crime Commissioner (PCC) Sarah Taylor resigned, Sutton comfortably won the election to replace her.

PCCs are elected officials who set the priorities of a police force, appoint a chief constable and hold them to account.

This week, promoters of Sutton's "Makings of a Murderer" show announced he was set to tour the country from January to November next year.

One stretch will see him visit Consett in County Durham, Tamworth in Staffordshire, Hunstanton in Norfolk, Llandudno in north Wales and Leeds over five consecutive nights.

A drive from venue to venue in that run would cover almost 700 miles (1,126km).

South Norfolk MP Goldsborough criticised Sutton's decision and said: "If Colin Sutton wants to be a celebrity that's his choice, but Norfolk deserves a police and crime commissioner whose first priority is Norfolk."

Matthew Taylor, a Conservative county councillor who finished second in the PCC election, said he was "shocked" to learn of the former detective's plans for a long run in theatres.

"If there is a major incident, you would expect the police and crime commissioner to be there, front and centre," he said.

"Not operationally, that's down to the chief constable, but in terms of lending his support, communicating with the public, being active and visible."

A spokeswoman for the Office of the Police and Crime Commissioner for Norfolk said his activities were "being undertaken in a private capacity...in his own time" and that he would "remain available and contactable should any business require his attention".

"Based on these assurances, we are satisfied that appropriate arrangements are in place and that there is no adverse impact on the performance of the commissioner's official responsibilities," she added.

Next week Sutton is due to launch a public consultation on policing priorities for Norfolk.

articles.title: I Tried the “Close Your Eyes and Pick” Decluttering Method—It Helped Me Clear Out Clothes I Didn’t Even Realize I Hated
articles.summary: Consider this the lazy girl’s Marie Kondo method.
articles.body:
The "close your eyes and pick" decluttering method involves randomly selecting items from your closet and deciding whether to keep or discard them based on your initial reaction.

This technique is similar to the Marie Kondo method, where items that don't spark joy are gradually eliminated over time through a fun game of chance.

By using this method, individuals can quickly and easily declutter their belongings, leading to a more organized space and potentially discovering new outfit combinations.

If there's one thing we love at REAL SIMPLE, it's a new decluttering technique that might help us deal with the daily onslaught of clutter in our homes. So we're always on the hunt for fresh tactics, whether it's a method that can clear a lot of clutter quickly, or a technique that works a little bit at a time and can be worked into your day.

So when we stumbled upon the "close your eyes and pick" decluttering method, we knew we had to give it a whirl.

What Is the Close Your Eyes and Pick Decluttering Method?

We found this clever decluttering method on Reddit's decluttering thread, where Redditor NorthChicago_girl shared how this helped her clear more clothes from a closet she already thought was fully decluttered. When she had to get dressed quickly, she decided to close her eyes and just pick something. "The first thing I grabbed I thought, 'I hate the way this material feels when I wear it.' I threw it on anyway...By the time I got back to my apartment, I knew I was getting rid of that shirt. I've been closing my eyes and picking something all week. I've gotten rid of two items already."

Basically, this decluttering method feels kind of like a lazy Marie Kondo method, where the items that don't spark joy when you grab them are culled over days, with a little fun game of chance thrown into the mix. (You never know what you're going to pick out with your eyes closed!)

What We Thought About the Close Your Eyes and Pick Method

This seems to be a technique that works best with larger collections of things, such as a set of clothing of the same type (i.e., your sweaters or t-shirts), books, board games, shoes, or coffee mugs.

I tried the original poster's method over the course of a week: I stashed a to-go bag in my closet, and every day, I closed my eyes and pulled out a top and bottom to wear. If I loved them both, I got dressed.

And if I felt bad about what I pulled at random, I thought hard about it. Was it just that the pairing didn't work too well together? (Emerald green leggings and a bright orange t-shirt was one unfortunate eyes-closed pick that went back into the drawer.) Or was it that I didn't love or need one or both of the picked items? If that was the case, into the bag it went.

For this project, I tried closing my eyes and reaching deep into my drawers and the back of my closet, as that's where I know the stuff that isn't in heavy rotation tends to reside. And it felt like every day I found something to give away. I cut my ratty "deep clean and painting" shirt stash to two, and ditched a few pairs of pants that no longer fit me well. A pilled sweater that made me sad didn't end up in the to-go bag, but I did pull out the clothes shaver to spruce it up.

In the end, after a week of very low effort, I had filled a tote with a bunch of items that no longer suited me—and had a little more space in my drawers and closet. It also led me to take more action to get items mended—like that pilled sweater, which probably would have just sat in the drawer all season without a little fabric shaver action.

And to be honest, it was kind of fun leaving my clothing selections to chance. I ended up wearing some things that I hadn't in a while, and tried some outfits that I never would have put together, but that totally worked—so it helped get me out of a wardrobe rut.

While I used this method the low-and-slow way, you could also use this for a much quicker destash. I'm thinking it would be perfect during the change of seasons, as you close your eyes and pick out a sweater or bathing suit and decide whether it's still something you're excited to wear. Turns out, you don't need to put in a lot of effort or time to declutter—you just need to close your eyes and pick something.

articles.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
articles.summary: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.
articles.body:
Israel's military says it has destroyed a large underground complex operated by Hezbollah in southern Lebanon.

It said it used more than 1,000 tonnes of explosives to destroy two tunnels spanning more than 2km (1.2 miles) beneath the Ali Taher Ridge.

The blast triggered seismic activity equivalent to a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

There was no immediate public response from Hezbollah or the Lebanese government.

Israeli forces took control of the ridge last week after months of fighting with the Iran-backed group there. The Israeli military occupies a large swathe of southern Lebanon captured after the conflict with Hezbollah resumed in March.

Images released by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) showed a fireball lighting up the sky.

"The sky lit up and about 15 seconds later we heard the terrifying sound," Ahamed, a resident in Nabatieh, about 6km west of the ridge, told the BBC.

"The house shook all together as if it was literally an earthquake."

He said people were screaming and children were crying, and that cars filled the roads as people left the area for Beirut.

Tremors were even felt in the coastal city of Saida 40km north.

The IDF said the underground infrastructure included a command centre used by Hezbollah's Badr unit and contained dozens of rockets, missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as anti-tank weapons, mines and explosives.

"This was strategic infrastructure that was constructed over two decades, funded and planned by the Iranian terror regime," the IDF said in a statement on Telegram.

"All of the terrorists who were inside the infrastructure were eliminated or fled."

The IDF said the destruction of the complex completed a mission to destroy eight tunnels and establish a "security zone" in the area.

The latest action comes amid renewed fighting in southern Lebanon, where Israeli forces have expanded operations against Hezbollah positions and continue to hold what Israel describes as a security zone near the border.

Lebanese media reported fresh Israeli strikes elsewhere in the south on Thursday, including Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Mansouri in the Tyre district.

The Lebanese army has increased deployments in areas outside Israeli control, including the southern city of Nabatieh, in efforts to strengthen stability and reassure residents, local television station MTV reported.

Lebanon was drawn into the war between Israel, the US and Iran on 2 March, when Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel in retaliation for a strike that killed Iran's supreme leader.

Israel responded by launching a bombing campaign across Lebanon and invading a significant part of the country's south. Its forces continue to occupy roughly 5% of Lebanese territory.

Fighting decreased following a ceasefire deal between Iran and the US in June, alongside a separate agreement between Lebanon and Israel.

The UN says about 330,000 people in Lebanon remain displaced by the conflict, with Israeli military activity, air strikes, destruction and restrictions on returning to Israeli-occupied areas preventing many from going home.

Under the Lebanon-Israel framework, Hezbollah is expected to disarm, Israeli forces to withdraw gradually from southern Lebanon and the Lebanese army to deploy across the area.

Hezbollah was not directly involved in the agreement and has rejected direct negotiations.

Despite a reduction in fighting, Israeli strikes and demolitions in southern Lebanon have continued.

At least 4,383 people - including 395 women and 259 children - have been killed in Lebanon by Israeli attacks since 2 March, according to the health ministry, whose figures do not differentiate between combatants and civilians. At least 29 have been killed this week, the ministry says.

Israeli authorities say 40 Israeli soldiers and four civilians have been killed in the same period.

articles.body: With the 18th Brics Summit under way in New Delhi, key developments have already emerged from the high-level engagements. Prime Minister Narendra Modi held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin, gifting him a Russian translation of the Thirukkural, while Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met PM Modi. Chinese President Xi Jinping is also due to arrive on Saturday for the summit and bilateral talks.India is hosting the September 12-13 summit under its 2026 chairship theme, “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability”. The expanded Brics grouping, which now has 11 members, is expected to focus on development, trade, technology, sustainability and strengthening cooperation among emerging economies and the Global South.PM Modi-Putin talks, Thirukkural gift & carpoolingPrime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin held bilateral talks, with trade, industrial cooperation, civil nuclear energy and other areas of strategic partnership being prominent in the discussions ahead of the 18th Brics Summit.They reviewed progress in bilateral cooperation across political, economic, defence, energy, space, skill mobility and people-to-people ties. They welcomed Russia’s INNOPROM India exhibition, held for the first time in India, and stressed its role in expanding trade and industrial cooperation, according to an MEA statement.The leaders also visited the exhibition and interacted with participants.The two leaders also discussed India-Russia engagement in Brics under India’s 2026 chairship, along with key regional and global issues, including the conflicts in West Asia and the Black Sea region and their impact on maritime trade and the safety of Indian seafarers. PM Modi reiterated that dialogue and diplomacy were the way forward in resolving conflicts and said India was ready to assist in peace efforts."They also exchanged views on issues of mutual interest in the regional and global sphere, including conflicts in West Asia and the Black Sea region. PM reiterated that dialogue and diplomacy remains the way forward in resolving conflicts and India stands ready to assist in peace efforts," MEA said in a statement.Moreover, Putin invited PM Modi to visit Russia for the 24th India-Russia annual summit, and Modi accepted the invitation, the MEA said.During the meeting, PM Modi gifted Putin a Russian translation of the Thirukkural, the classical Tamil work attributed to poet-saint Thiruvalluvar. Modi said the translation would carry Thiruvalluvar’s “eternal wisdom” across languages and borders."Presented President Putin with a Russian translation of the Thirukkural, which carries the eternal wisdom of the great Thiruvalluvar across languages and borders," PM Modi said in a post on X.After the bilateral meeting, PM Modi and Putin shared a car as they travelled to an exhibition at Bharat Mandapam.PM Modi, Pezeshkian hold bilateral talksPM Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian held a bilateral meeting on the sidelines of Brics Summit. He said the grouping’s strength would be better realised by building stronger networks of trade, investment and joint financing among member countries.Pezeshkian also flagged geopolitical uncertainty, supply-chain disruptions and the increasing use of economic instruments as a means of political pressure.Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian arrived in New Delhi for the 18th Brics Summit. Beijing said the two countries should view ties from a strategic and long-term perspective, strengthen communication, enhance cooperation and properly handle their differences.The PM Modi-Xi meeting comes as India and China work to stabilise ties following the 2020 Eastern Ladakh standoff. articles.title: Kate visits cancer patients in hospital she helped fund with climb
articles.summary: The princess completed the Three Peaks Challenge in aid of the hospital where she was treated for cancer.
articles.body:
Catherine, Princess of Wales has visited the hospital where she was treated for cancer after completing a charity climb earlier this year to help fund a new unit there.

"This was my small way of being able to give back and say thank you," Catherine told staff at the Royal Marsden in London on Friday .

The princess, who revealed two years ago that she was receiving cancer treatment, carried out the Three Peaks Challenge in aid of the hospital , which involved climbing the highest peaks in England, Scotland and Wales within 24 hours.

The amount of money she raised has not been made public, but it will go towards a new unit offering complementary healing alongside clinical care.

The princess spoke to patients and staff at the hospital about the importance of support which goes beyond the physical.

"I had incredible care here and support from a huge team and I'm really, really grateful on a personal level," she said.

"But also the holistic care, the treatments and therapeutic support on the outside is so important.

"It makes a big difference - the impact of nature, the impact of good nutrition, good ongoing support around you when it's really difficult to manage the trials and tribulations of medical treatments," she reflected.

Catherine sat down and chatted to those receiving treatment at the hospital, including patients with breast cancer, head and neck cancer and a brain tumour.

"When you first get cancer, you're very aware of the physical impact," a patient told her. "The mental impact comes after."

He said it had been a "lifesaver" to be able to talk to a therapist at the hospital, because "there is only so much you can say to your friends and family".

The princess agreed: "Cancer is not just the physical changes your body is going through.

"There's a mind-body aspect that changes who you are... having professionals who can help you navigate that is really essential," she said.

Another patient said she had gone from being aged 46 to feeling "like I was 86".

Catherine, who announced in January 2025 that she was in remission, agreed about the need to support the whole person - saying holistic treatment helped patients "adjust to the lifestyle change that cancer has brought".

She also heard from a patient who spoke of wanting to seek out new experiences after being diagnosed: "There are those moments where you fall down a bit, like, 'what's going on?' And you need to find inspiration."

The princess agreed, saying that it showed the importance of "making the most of life".

Speaking after Catherine's visit, one patient particularly welcomed her being there due to her personal experience of cancer: "I forgot that she was a princess. I was just talking to every other cancer patient who has been in this ward."

"You all become friends, part of a community, and I was talking to her on that level, rather than the Princess of Wales," he said.

Money raised by her mountain climbs in June will now be used for the The Centre for Holistic Wellbeing and Recovery.

It is intended to offer cancer patients a wider sense of recovery, beyond physical treatment, and addressing a sense of emotional, spiritual and social wellbeing.

She previously said the challenge was a "chance to explore life beyond diagnosis", as well as giving back.

Catherine's trip to the London hospital follows a visit on Thursday with her husband Prince William to support a suicide prevention project being launched in Liverpool.

articles.title: From 2017 to 2019, people in Japan donated 6.21 million used phones and 79,000 tons of electronic devices; recyclers then used them to make 5,000 medals for the Tokyo Olympic and Paralympic Games
articles.summary: Rest of World News: From April 2017 to March 2019, Japan collected electronics through two national channels. Under the 2020 Medal Project, NTT Docomo shops took in about.
articles.body: From April 2017 to March 2019, Japan collected electronics through two national channels. Under the 2020 Medal Project, NTT Docomo shops took in about 6.21 million used phones, while municipalities collected approximately 78,985 tonnes of small electronic devices. Through them all, recyclers were able to extract 32 kilograms of gold, 3,500 kilograms of silver and 2,200 kilograms of bronze. These were then used to make the 5,000 Olympic and Paralympic medals.Two collection streamsThe project ran from April 1, 2017 to March 31, 2019. An official Tokyo 2020 sustainability report separates the two figures: municipal collection produced the 78,985-tonne total, while about 2,300 NTT Docomo shops collected 6.21 million phones. One counts handsets collected through phone shops. The other measures the mass of a much broader municipal stream that included mobile phones and other consumer electronics such as cameras, laptops and handheld game systems.Participation became national in scale. The report records 1,621 local governments, more than 90 per cent of Japan’s municipalities, alongside support from 38 companies, central-government buildings and collection points run by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government.The lengthy processA phone holds useful metals in circuit boards, contacts, wiring and other components but none are pure. The project’s documented process moved through collection, classification, dismantling, extraction and refining before manufacturers received usable metal. Electronics use gold because it conducts electricity reliably and resists corrosion. Silver and copper also carry current efficiently. A single handset contains only small amounts, often spread across thin contacts and circuit-board traces, but millions of devices turn those fragments into industrial feedstock.Japan already had a legal framework for that chain. The Small Home Appliance Recycling Act took effect in April 2013 and covered more than 100 kinds of electrical or battery-powered household products. Municipalities could choose what to collect, while government-certified operators dismantled, crushed and sorted devices into resource streams.The medal campaign used that infrastructure for a visible, time-limited objective. Donation boxes supplied a reason to return devices that might otherwise remain in drawers or enter ordinary waste, while certified businesses handled the less photogenic work of separating mixed materials.Gold, silver and bronzeThe Tokyo 2020 media guide reports final secured amounts of about 32 kilograms of gold, 3,500 kilograms of silver and 2,200 kilograms of bronze material. The report uses familiar medal labels, but “bronze” is not a pure chemical element. Tokyo’s bronze medals were made from a copper-rich alloy.The gold label also needs context. A modern Olympic gold medal is not solid gold. Tokyo’s first-place medals used a pure-silver body plated with more than six grams of gold, while silver medals were pure silver. The large recovered silver total therefore served both gold and silver medal production.An official Tokyo 2020 legacy report records approximately 5,000 medals produced for the two Games.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Lost city where Jesus performed miracles has finally been identified, expert says
articles.summary: Bethsaida, the home of Apostle Peter and the setting of Jesus Christ's miracles, may finally be identified after a decade of archaeology work at El-Araj.
articles.body: Archaeologists believe they've identified a lost city tied to Jesus Christ's ministry after a decade of excavations, with the project's academic director saying he's "100%" certain about the discovery. The El-Araj Excavation Project, led by Mordechai Aviam, has been digging at the archaeological site along the Sea of Galilee since 2016. Bethsaida, close to Jesus' ministry in Capernaum, was once the home of the apostles Peter, Andrew and Philip. AUTHOR DINESH D'SOUZA CHALLENGES BIBLE SKEPTICS WITH 'STARTLING' ARCHAEOLOGICAL DISCOVERIES The city was the setting of several of Jesus' miracles, including the healing of a blind man. Jesus' feeding of the 5,000 took place on Bethsaida's outskirts, according to the Gospels. Over the past decade, researchers have uncovered extensive evidence of an ancient Jewish fishing settlement and Roman-era city at the El-Araj site. This year's excavation opened new areas of the site, revealing additional Roman period remains and pottery, Steven Notley, a biblical scholar and academic director of the El-Araj Excavation Project, told Fox News Digital. ANCIENT BOOK OF REVELATION CITY GIVES UP STUNNING SECRET BURIED FOR 1,500 YEARS Researchers have also recovered over 200 coins, which are being studied to help date the settlement. Notley, dean of religious studies at Pillar College in New Jersey, said an unexpected wildfire last year helped researchers gain a better understanding of the size of the ancient settlement. "We actually had a wildfire, which at first we thought was tragic," Notley said. "But it actually cleared the underbrush and allowed us to do an extended survey to determine the size of the settlement. It's at least 15 acres." The team has also uncovered Jewish stone vessels, a Roman bathhouse and a Byzantine basilica containing an inscription linked to the Apostle Peter. LOST CITY TIED TO BIBLICAL EXODUS MAY HAVE FINALLY BEEN DISCOVERED IN EGYPT Notley indicated that researchers looking for Bethsaida would expect to find evidence of two things: a Jewish fishing village and its later transformation into a small Roman city. Excavations at El-Araj have revealed evidence of both, he said, including thousands of lead fishing weights, stone vessels associated with Jewish settlement and the remains of a Roman bathhouse. "The two things that we should be finding if we're excavating that sort of coincide with that identification are a Jewish fishing village which, again, we've found ample evidence of that and evidence of a polis of urbanization," Notley said. After a decade of excavations, Notley is now "100%" confident that El-Araj is Bethsaida, he told Fox News Digital. ARCHAEOLOGISTS UNEARTH SECRET CHURCH TIED TO COUNCIL OF NICAEA, CHRISTIANITY'S DEFINING MOMENT Rather than a single discovery proving the site's identity, Notley said the case for Bethsaida has been built over years of excavation. "It's [the] accumulation of evidence that you continually find," he said. "Since 2016, we have not uncovered a single thing that would challenge or question the identification of the site as Bethsaida," Notley added. "Instead, everything we find each season, the evidence gets stronger and stronger and strong." In the Byzantine basilica, excavators found an inscription referencing "the Chief of the Apostles and the Keeper of the Keys of Heaven," or the Apostle Peter.
